race.comment: AMUSEANTES (10) dominated her rivals fresh at Doomben and was okay last time but perhaps left a touch flat-footed second-up. Should be hitting her straps now. HUON (7) comes up highway and is going better than his form reads. Is drawn sticky but gets a key booking in Thompson and can make his presence felt at a nice quote. TONNEOFGRIT (5) improved sharply second-up when missing narrowly at the Sunny Coast. Suited by the rise to 1200m and can play a major role with third-up improvement. ESTRONDO (6) was only fair resuming but can improve quickly with that run under his belt. Has peaks that stack up and Pozman's 3kg claim gives him a good helping hand. MEAN APPROACH (1) hasn't done much wrong this campaign and comes through strong form references. Have to take seriously. NO DRAMA (2) is an intriguing ex-NSW galloper making his stable debut for the Geran camp. Is 4/6 over this trip and if he's in good order, he'll be in the finish.
